verdict.rationale: Temporal provides an embedded local dev service (`temporal server start-dev`) with its own Web UI, fully separate from production, and Namespace isolation for staging/prod separation, which together allow testing workflows without touching production data. However, there is no explicit 'sandbox' feature, no AI-specific mocking of model/tool calls, and no dedicated staging guidance tailored to AI agent testing. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging documentation for AI workflows, mock/replay tooling for agent calls, independent confirmation that dev server isolation is used this way in practice.
